C1_monotone_severity_null.null_hypothesis: H0 MONOTONE SEVERITY: substrate corrosion rate is monotone non-decreasing in chemical concentration at fixed (material, environment, temperature), for EVERY (material, environment, temperature) system -- the universal form a severity scalar would need

primary_test_family_wise_decisive_violat.rule: a series is a DECISIVE violation if classified NON_MONOTONE_PEAK, its shape p survives Bonferroni over all 166 (peak+valley) tests at alpha=0.05, and the peak-to-top-concentration collapse is >= 1 log10; ONE decisive series refutes the universal H0

secondary_test_global_enrichment.rule: exact binomial upper tail of peak detections vs the alpha false-positive budget over testable series

C1_monotone_severity_null.verdict_note: most systems ARE monotone increasing (that is real chemistry, e.g. HCl on stainless); the refutation is of the UNIVERSAL monotone-severity assumption, carried by the passivating systems exactly where the 1836/1986 literature predicts

C2_shape_classification.note: NON_MONOTONE requires (i) the piecewise-monotone (PAVA) fit to beat the best monotone fit by >= the margin, (ii) the empirical extremum at an interior concentration, AND (iii) a per-series permutation-calibrated shape p < alpha -- the third gate makes the detector self-calibrating against the shuffled-noise process that fools a bare margin rule

fontana_stainless_sulfuric.prediction: Fontana 1986 isocorrosion charts: austenitic stainless (304/316/317 family) in H2SO4 shows an INTERIOR rate maximum and passivation collapse in the concentrated (>=90 wt%) regime

marine_chloride_stratum.power_flag: UNDERPOWERED: chemical-process acid environments dominate the cohort; the marine-relevant NaCl stratum is too small to score

schoenbein_faraday_iron_nitric.honesty_note: absence of an iron/plain-steel HNO3 concentration ladder in the retained cohort is reported as-is; the named prediction is NOT scored on other materials
schoenbein_faraday_iron_nitric.prediction: Schoenbein/Faraday 1836: iron or plain steel attacked by dilute HNO3, passive in concentrated HNO3 (rate decreasing at high concentration)

C4_hostile_null_shuffled_concentrations.honesty_note: global peak enrichment over the false-positive budget is MARGINAL (exact binomial p reported above); the universal-H0 refutation therefore rests on the family-wise DECISIVE series (C1 primary test), not on the aggregate count
C4_hostile_null_shuffled_concentrations.protocol: per-series permutation calibration: rates shuffled across concentrations within each series (stage 1 1000 shuffles/series; stage 2 20000 shuffles for series at the stage-1 floor; deterministic per-series seeds); the same statistic (piecewise-monotone R^2 improvement) is computed on every shuffle, so the detector is self-calibrating against the exact noise process that fools a bare margin rule

C5_concentration_blind_ml_consequence.interpretation: the median within-series spread across concentration alone exceeds the replicate noise floor: concentration is a REAL, unmodeled severity axis for the shipped concentration-blind QSPR, and it is NOT monotone -- a monotone 'more acid = worse' feature would be wrong for the passivating systems
C5_concentration_blind_ml_consequence.shipped_feature_source: corr-rate-qspr-v1 / corr-rate-conformal-v1 features: alloy composition + environment flags + temperature; concentration_text is NOT a feature

verdict.consequence_for_the_module: A barrier-corrosion severity input CANNOT treat chemical concentration as a monotone aggressiveness scalar: the 1836/1986 passivation literature predicts, and NIST CORR-DATA confirms, interior rate maxima with order-of-magnitude collapse in the concentrated regime. The shipped concentration-blind QSPR features leave this axis entirely unmodeled (C5); any future concentration feature must be shape-free (per-series or spline), not monotone-constrained.
verdict.headline: H0_REFUTED_AS_UNIVERSAL_LAW: 2 series (304 in Sulfuric Acid) are family-wise DECISIVE non-monotone violations of 'more concentrated = more corrosive' (Bonferroni m=166, peak-to-top-concentration collapse 2.3-2.4 log10), consistent with the 1836 Schoenbein/Faraday passivity observation and the Fontana 1986 isocorrosion charts (CORROBORATED: 16/17 retained stainless/H2SO4 series show an interior rate maximum; 10/11 series reaching >=90 wt% show a >=10x concentrated-regime collapse). Global peak enrichment beyond the alpha budget is MARGINAL (exact binomial p=0.056, 8 peaks vs 4.2 expected false): most systems ARE monotone increasing; the refutation is of the UNIVERSAL monotone-severity assumption.
